import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedShuffleSplit
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from scipy.sparse import hstack

# Setup paths and directories
TRAIN_PATH = "./input/train.csv"
TEST_PATH = "./input/test.csv"
SUB_DIR = "./submission/"
os.makedirs(SUB_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Load datasets
train = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
test = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)

# Map authors to integer labels
col_to_class = {"EAP": 0, "HPL": 1, "MWS": 2}
y_full = train["author"].map(col_to_class).values
X_texts = train["text"].fillna("")

# Create a stratified train/validation split for hold-out evaluation
splitter = StratifiedShuffleSplit(n_splits=1, test_size=0.2, random_state=42)
train_idx, val_idx = next(splitter.split(X_texts, y_full))

X_train, y_train = X_texts.iloc[train_idx], y_full[train_idx]
X_val, y_val = X_texts.iloc[val_idx], y_full[val_idx]


# Enhanced Style Features Extraction
def extract_enhanced_features(text_series):
    texts = text_series.fillna("").astype(str).str.strip()
    lengths = texts.str.len()

    # Tokenization
    tokens = texts.str.split().apply(len)
    tokens_safe = tokens.replace(0, 1)

    # Lexical Diversity (Type-Token Ratio)
    unique_tokens = texts.str.split().apply(lambda s: len(set(s)))
    ttr = unique_tokens / tokens_safe

    # Syntactic Variance & Average Length
    word_lens = texts.str.split().apply(lambda s: [len(w) for w in s])
    avg_lens = word_lens.apply(lambda x: np.mean(x) if x else 0.0)
    std_lens = word_lens.apply(lambda x: np.std(x) if len(x) > 1 else 0.0)

    # Percentage of Long Words (>6 chars)
    long_words = word_lens.apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for l in x if l > 6) / len(x) if x else 0.0
    )

    # Punctuation & Uppercase Ratios
    punct_ratios = texts.apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for c in x if not c.isalnum() and not c.isspace())
        / max(len(x), 1)
    )
    upper_ratios = texts.apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for c in x if c.isupper()) / max(len(x), 1)
    )

    return np.column_stack(
        [lengths, avg_lens, std_lens, ttr, long_words, punct_ratios, upper_ratios]
    )


# Compute and scale dense features
X_train_feats = extract_enhanced_features(X_train)
val_feats = extract_enhanced_features(X_val)
test_feats = extract_enhanced_features(test["text"])

style_scaler = StandardScaler().fit(X_train_feats)
X_train_dense = style_scaler.transform(X_train_feats)
X_val_dense = style_scaler.transform(val_feats)
X_test_dense = style_scaler.transform(test_feats)

# Feature Engineering: Combined Word and Character n-gram TF-IDF
vec_word = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="word", ngram_range=(1, 4), sublinear_tf=True, min_df=3
)
vec_char = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char_wb", ngram_range=(2, 6), sublinear_tf=True, min_df=3
)

# Fit vectorizers on the training split only
vec_word.fit(X_train)
vec_char.fit(X_train)


def build_sparse_features(text_series):
    return hstack([vec_word.transform(text_series), vec_char.transform(text_series)])


X_train_sparse = build_sparse_features(X_train)
X_val_sparse = build_sparse_features(X_val)

# Combine sparse TF-IDF with dense style features
X_train_combined = hstack([X_train_sparse, X_train_dense])
X_val_combined = hstack([X_val_sparse, X_val_dense])

# Train classifier on hold-out training data
clf = LogisticRegression(
    C=5.0, multi_class="multinomial", solver="lbfgs", max_iter=2000
)
clf.fit(X_train_combined, y_train)

# Evaluate on hold-out validation set
val_probs = clf.predict_proba(X_val_combined)
val_probs = np.clip(val_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
val_probs /= val_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

val_logloss = log_loss(y_val, val_probs, labels=[0, 1, 2])
print(f"Multi-class Log Loss: {val_logloss:.6f}")

# Retrain on the full training dataset for final submission
vec_word.fit(X_texts)
vec_char.fit(X_texts)
X_full_sparse = build_sparse_features(X_texts)
full_dense = style_scaler.transform(extract_enhanced_features(X_texts))

clf_final = LogisticRegression(
    C=5.0, multi_class="multinomial", solver="lbfgs", max_iter=2000
)
clf_final.fit(hstack([X_full_sparse, full_dense]), y_full)

# Generate predictions for the unlabeled test set
X_test_sparse = build_sparse_features(test["text"])
test_probs = clf_final.predict_proba(hstack([X_test_sparse, X_test_dense]))
test_probs = np.clip(test_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
test_probs /= test_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

# Construct and save submission file
submission = pd.DataFrame(test_probs, columns=["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"])
submission.insert(0, "id", test["id"])
submission.to_csv(os.path.join(SUB_DIR, "submission.csv"), index=False)
print("Submission successfully saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
